row: When you want to revolutionize the clothing industry, you can’t just slap some extra fabric on a vest and call it a day. You may think, “It’s just pockets, it’s not like it’s rocket science.” But you would be wrong! When you’re adding as many as 42 pockets onto a piece of clothing, each with its own engineered purpose, there is a laundry list of considerations and challenges. What will be going in these pockets? How heavy will it be? Should the pockets be hidden? Should we add a zipper? Velcro? Magnets! So yeah… not rocket science, but definitely Pocket Science! And while they’re not sending monkeys into space, we think our Scientists are pretty darn special.
